title: Java Virtual Threads — Companion Resources
title_es: Hilos Virtuales de Java — Recursos complementarios
description: Runnable JDK 21+/25 examples: Thread.ofVirtual, newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor, StructuredTaskScope.open() with Joiner policies, ScopedValue, platform/virtual mix, locking without pinning, and bounded fan-out with Semaphore.
